notes.title: Demo update and hotfix (version 0.4.4)
notes.notes: [p]Dear players, thank you for submitting your feedback and bug reports through the [b]Night in Delirium demo survey[/b].[/p][p]We've been working on an update to fix the issues you reported and improve the tutorial's gameplay (especially in the bar section).[/p][p][/p][p]This update is now live and will download automatically or when you launch the game.[/p][p][/p][p]Below is a detailed list of changes:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed bugs when preparing drinks in the bar.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed selected items remaining active after exiting the bar.[/p][/*][*][p]Highlighted hint recipe buttons on the bar creation dialogue screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased font size and background color contrast for tutorial messages.[/p][/*][*][p]Simplified tutorial instructions for better information flow.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the map music volume.[/p][/*][*][p]Replaced the "click on map" prompt between events with a character dialogue cue.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed early reveal of character names on the Stats screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected errors in the English translation.[/p][/*][/list][p]That's it for now! We hope you have a great week and remember that you can always share your feedback if you encounter any issues, or if you just want to let us know what you liked about the demo. See ya![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfoun1LtLP35gr3QoILp09MXO0wrAAS4vmQ7CNXDYy7FfjFuQ/viewform" style="button"]Feedback Survey[/url][/p]

notes.title: Feedback survey for the demo (v0.4.3)
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone! Thank you so much for trying out our “Night in Delirium” demo.[/p][p][/p][p]If you’ve already played it, we’d love to hear your thoughts. Your feedback helps other players discover the demo and helps us continue improving the game.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve also prepared a short survey where you can share more detailed impressions or report any bugs you encountered. [/p][p][/p][p][url="https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfoun1LtLP35gr3QoILp09MXO0wrAAS4vmQ7CNXDYy7FfjFuQ/viewform?usp=header" style="button"]Feedback Survey[/url][/p][p][/p][p]We’re currently working on an update based on the feedback we’ve received, and on the upcoming “Early Access” version of the game. It will include new chapters that delve deeper into the story, the characters, and the mystery surrounding the Aguasvivas killer.[/p][p][/p][p]Follow us on social media to stay updated on our progress. If you have any questions or comments, feel free to reply to this post or start a new topic in the Steam Discussion forum.[/p][p][b]Thanks again for your support — see you soon![/b][/p][p][/p]
